# Distinguish absent folder counts from zero and from storage size

Current reporting initializes the known folderTotalMessages labels, Other and Total to zero, then replaces positive totals. It does not initialize all folderSizeOnDisk labels to zero in the same loop. Preserve that distinction when reasoning about absent labels or repeated reporting. Bytes from a particular mbox fixture are not a general storage size per message. The browser fixtures and assertions were inspected; no fresh profile or on-disk measurement was made.

Scope: Folder telemetry snapshot limits.
